description: This file defines the 'PunchOutController' class within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It handles pre-render logic for the punch-out process, including retrieving the last punch record, redirecting if necessary, and configuring the attendance punch-out component.

classes.name: PunchOutController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling punch-out related pre-render logic in HRM attendance module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the attendance punch-out component, retrieves previous punch record, redirects if none found, and configures component properties based on user permissions.
